medical_online.source_text: I'm here. Medical systems are coming back online on emergency power.

occupant_detected.source_text: I've got you. Your metabolic activity is dangerously low, but you're stable.

contamination.source_text: The suspension fluid is contaminated. Filtration has failed. I need to get you out.

filtration_offline.source_text: The filters aren't responding. We can't wait any longer.

revival_authorized.source_text: I'm starting an emergency revival. Bringing your temperature up slowly.

thermal_restoration.source_text: Core temperature is rising. That's it. Nice and steady.

circulatory_assist.source_text: Restoring blood flow to your brain and heart.

cryoprotectant_purge.source_text: Clearing the cryoprotectant from your bloodstream.

reanimation_compound.source_text: Administering a circulatory stimulant. Stay with me.

cardiac_low.source_text: I have electrical activity, but your heart isn't moving enough blood.

pacing.source_text: Your heart isn't responding. I'm going to pace it. Three, two, one.

respiratory_response.source_text: Good. You're breathing on your own.

draining.source_text: Circulation is returning. I'm draining the contaminated fluid now. Keep breathing through the mask.

mask_releasing.source_text: Your oxygen is stable. I'm releasing the breathing mask.

move_slowly.source_text: Your balance will be poor. Stay still for a moment.

awake.source_text: Your pupils are responding. You're waking up. Take it slowly.

aether_identity.source_text: I'm A.E.T.H.E.R. I was built to take care of this facility, and of you.

aether_limits.source_text: Some of my memory is damaged. A lot of the facility is still offline.

find_exit.source_text: This chamber isn't safe anymore. Find the exit. I'll guide you.
